description: Write the 「-----update-----」 part of cells in one row (e.g. H/I/J) and keep the original part byte-identical. No separator yet: appends blank line + separator + text. Separator present: mode=replace (default) swaps the update part, mode=append adds after it. Pass `expected` per column (sha256 from read_range) as the base check. After writing it verifies the original part is intact, then fills `fillRange` (default the updated columns of that row) with `fill` (default #FFFF00; null = no fill).

expected.description: Column letter -> exact current text or sha256:<hash>

file.description: Workbook: SharePoint URL, an alias from ~/.graph-excel/workbooks.json, or "driveId:itemId"

send.description: false (default) = dry run: shows what would change. true = write — only after the user approved (or a standing rule allows it)

sheet.description: Worksheet name exactly as listed by resolve

name: append_update
